# Ting-Chun Liu (劉庭均)

> Ting-Chun Liu is an artist working at the intersections of critical artificial intelligence, audiovisual media and network practice. Dissecting technological systems through feedback-driven interventions.

Areas: Critical artificial intelligence, Generative AI, Artistic research on AI, Media art, Audio-visual performance, Network and internet art, Feedback systems

## Main pages

- [Works](https://liutingchun.com/works/): installations, performances, internet art and artistic research
- [About / CV](https://liutingchun.com/about/): biography, teaching, exhibitions, talks, publications
- [Blog Archive](https://liutingchun.com/blog/): texts and technical notes (in Mandarin)
- [Audio-Visual Performance](https://liutingchun.com/performance/)
- [Press & Media](https://liutingchun.com/press/): talk recordings, texts and profile pages by others

The site is also available in German (https://liutingchun.com/de/) and Traditional Chinese (https://liutingchun.com/zh/).

## Works

- [Steering Through the Inner Residue](https://liutingchun.com/works/steering-through-the-inner-residue/) (2026): Video Installation
- [Interpolation of the Invisible Color](https://liutingchun.com/works/interpolation-of-the-invisible-color/) (2025): Curatorial Practice, Interactive Installation
- [Latent Heat Generation](https://liutingchun.com/works/latent-heat-generation/) (2025): Artistic Research
- [51 Ways to Spell the Image Giraffe](https://liutingchun.com/works/51-ways-to-spell-the-image-giraffe/) (2025): Artistic Research, Talk
- [Sixteen Tokens for a Cave](https://liutingchun.com/works/sixteen-tokens-for-a-cave/) (2025): Multimodal Poetry
- [Just Jailbreak](https://liutingchun.com/works/just-jailbreak/) (2024): Interactive game about jailbreaking a large language model
- [Self-cannibalizing AI](https://liutingchun.com/works/self-cannibalizing-ai/) (2023): Talk, 37C3 — Artistic strategies to expose generative text-to-image models
- [Achtung! Verwischung](https://liutingchun.com/works/achtung-verwischung/) (2023): Site-Specific Performance
- [Imaginary Landscape](https://liutingchun.com/works/imaginary-landscape/) (2022–23): Ongoing Project, Audio-Visual Performance
- [Beneath](https://liutingchun.com/works/beneath/) (2022): Sound Installation
- [Sun](https://liutingchun.com/works/sun/) (2020): Internet Art (p5.js website)
- [Bring Us Somewhere](https://liutingchun.com/works/bring-us-somewhere/) (2020): Video
- [Faces](https://liutingchun.com/works/faces/) (2020): Video
- [Segmentary Moonlight](https://liutingchun.com/works/segmentary-moonlight/) (2018): Light Installation
- [Message in a Bottle](https://liutingchun.com/works/message-in-a-bottle/) (2017): Facebook Posts
- [I kept repeating the unfamiliar self](https://liutingchun.com/works/i-kept-repeating-the-unfamiliar-self/) (2017): Video Installation
- [Light Segment](https://liutingchun.com/works/light-segment/) (2017): Light Installation
- [Inevitable Cross of The Parallel](https://liutingchun.com/works/inevitable-cross-of-the-parallel/) (2017): Performance Record
- [Take Off the Clothes](https://liutingchun.com/works/take-off-the-clothes/) (2017): Performance Record
- [Hyper-Link into Image](https://liutingchun.com/works/hyper-link-into-image/) (2016): Internet Art

## Contact

- GitHub: https://github.com/aprilcoffee

## About the artist

> Ting-Chun Liu is one of the most important critical artificial intelligence artists (#Critical AI Art) in Taiwan and Germany. He is interested in media specificity of Art in AI. He teaches AI art at the renowned Bauhaus-Universität Weimar.
